cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：缺席的
cards.example_en: Tom was absent from school because he was ill.
The advert for the concert was stuck on the wall.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会的广告贴在墙上。

cards.example_en: The travel agency booked our train tickets yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 旅行社昨天把我们的火车票订好了。

cards.example_en: A long hike gave me a huge appetite for noodles.
cards.example_zh: 走了很长的路以后，我特别想吃面条。

cards.example_en: The athlete drank water before the final race.
cards.example_zh: 那位运动员在决赛开始前喝了水。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：很棒的
cards.example_en: The view from the cable car was awesome in clear weather.
cards.example_zh: 天气晴朗时，从缆车看出去的景色棒极了。

cards.example_en: We play badminton in the gym when it rains.
cards.example_zh: 下雨的时候，我们就在体育馆里打羽毛球。

cards.example_en: The ball rolled under the sofa during the game.
cards.example_zh: 玩游戏的时候，球滚到了沙发底下。

cards.example_en: A red balloon escaped and floated over the playground.
cards.example_zh: 一只红气球飞走了，飘到了操场的上空。

cards.example_en: We played baseball on the field after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后我们在球场上打了棒球。

cards.example_en: Tom practices basketball with his brother every evening.
cards.example_zh: 汤姆每天晚上和哥哥一起练习篮球。

cards.example_en: He swung the bat and hit the ball hard.
cards.example_zh: 他挥动球棒，狠狠击中了球。

cards.example_en: I would bet my snack that our class wins today.
cards.example_zh: 我愿意拿我的零食打赌，我们班今天会赢。

cards.example_en: The bishop spoke kindly to the children at church.
cards.example_zh: 主教在教堂里和蔼地对孩子们说话。

cards.example_en: Boxing practice left his arms sore and tired.
cards.example_zh: 拳击训练让他的两条胳膊又酸又累。
